reviews.title: Just As Advertised
reviews.text:
The app has several stretches for just about every occasion whether it be warm up or cool down morning to get your day started or evening to wind you down.
Also, a good feature is a streak tracker to keep track of how many days in a row that you’ve stretched. Unfortunately, after day 158, there was a glitch and mine started all over again; very unfortunate. But I remember just keep track of it in my head and add it to the new streak I have going. Otherwise very good app.

reviews.title: No trial period
reviews.text: I should have known. Usually for an app like this you try it out for a couple of days and then you decide it is worth it to be part of your daily routine. It is for that reason, you understand why this app does not offer that. Only after you have purchased it do you see how terrible its interface is, not user friendly, pop-ups, no intuitive training programs, and very pedestrian stretches. If there had been a free trial I wouldn’t have to wish I got my money back.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Before proceeding to purchase this application, it is essential that you take the following into account. The time indicated to complete the exercises does not correspond to reality. For example, if you wish to complete an exercise that supposedly lasts 10 minutes, it will actually take you around 25 minutes. I reported this situation and what I found was a customer service that was extremely incompetent, rude, and unprofessional. This feels like a scam, and unfortunately, they are unwilling to refund my money. I feel cheated by this situation.
